title: stachys baicalensis var. hispidula
intro: Stachys baicalensis var. hispidula, commonly known as Chinese hedgehog betony, is a plant species in the mint family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include promoting relaxation and reducing stress through its health benefits, such as lowering blood pressure and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Stachys baicalensis var. hispidula include acting as an antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, making it useful for treating conditions like anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
